name: [NOW] Don't Steal the Stitch!
desc:
Welcome to Don't Steal the Stitch!

Steal sleeping Stitch and escape from the guards 😴
Upgrade and earn more money 💸
Build your Base and unlock Gears 🔒
Trade and gift Stitch 🎁
Shh… don’t wake them 🤫

Your Stitchs earn offline cash! 💤

Premium players get +10% cash boost!

If you’re having fun, like the game 👍 and tell your friends! 😄
**This is a fan made game...
